scores.claim_text: Bell MV-75 (FLRAA) program is a material Bell revenue driver with $1.3B prototype testing/evaluation award in 2025.
scores.M_value: Bell Textron has 9,192 DoD awards totaling $18.04B; top award is W58RGZ23C0001 explicitly titled 'FUTURE VERTICAL LIFT (FVL) FLRAA CAPABILITY SET THREE' with $3.54B obligated — directly corroborates FLRAA/MV-75 program. J-Book corpus has no FLRAA entry (coverage gap; not red flag per heuristic 9 because contracts confirm program existence).
scores.interpretation: Hard corroboration on Mode A. Bell Textron's largest single contract IS the FLRAA program ($3.54B obligated cumulative) — consistent with the $1.3B 2025 prototype phase award. Mode B J-Book absence is a corpus gap (FLRAA is a real, well-known U.S. Army program). PASS.

scores.claim_text: 102 plants (57 US + 45 non-US), 23.8M sq ft manufacturing footprint.
scores.M_check: epa_frs.query_facilities Mode A + osha_establishments.query_establishments Mode B
scores.M_value: OSHA found 61 establishments under various Textron names (Textron Systems, Kautex Textron, Textron Aviation, Bell Textron, etc.) across US states; NAICS codes 336411 (aircraft mfg) etc. EPA FRS RI alone shows 7 Textron facilities (incl. legacy 'Gorham Division', 'Speidel Div', 'Textron Aircraft', 'Textron Aviation', 'Textron Inc.'); EPA FRS TX shows 'BELL TEXTRON PLANT 3' Fort Worth.
scores.interpretation: Footprint independently verifiable in OSHA + EPA FRS registries. 61 US OSHA establishments understandably less than 57 plants because many plants house multiple establishments / not all reported in OSHA inspection set, but order-of-magnitude consistent. PASS.

scores.claim_text: Delivered 171 Citation jets, 146 turboprops, 169 commercial helicopters in 2025.
scores.M_check: uspto_odp.query_assignee(Textron Innovations) Mode A + Bell Textron assignee Mode B (proxy: ongoing engineering/IP investment supports stated production)
scores.M_value: Textron Innovations Inc.: 811 applications, 651 granted patents (cutoff 2026-05-20). Bell Textron Inc.: 390 apps, 315 granted. Recent grants include rotorcraft tech, VTOL, battery systems, neural-network technician AR. Patent flow shows active R&D consistent with operating aircraft programs.
scores.interpretation: While USPTO does not directly verify unit deliveries, the deep & current patent estate (>950 combined granted) for the relevant assignees is consistent with claimed ongoing aircraft production. No registry contradicts the delivery counts. PASS per heuristic 8 (patents PASS when >=5 granted with claimed-category hits).
